title: PWR-B power mezzanine (PWR_BRANCH_SW + USB_POWER_SW): LNA and USB branch switches, monitors, harness headers
note: W2 PCB-PWRB. Generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_B/make_spec.py (do not hand-edit; rerun it). Placement, the B2B pin map and the scripted copper are design choices of this package (build/15 rows W2 PCB-PWRB); KiCad DRC, the audits and check_boards are CI/model results. Not a fabrication release; mezzanine fit, heat and every bench gate stay OPEN.

layers.source: build/15 Шари (4-layer JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer) and mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup

plan.F.Cu: parts (top side only), LAB5 trunk and Kelvin copper, signals, GND pour
plan.In1.Cu: solid GND plane (layer type power: the router puts only vias through it)
plan.B.Cu: B2B placeholder (bottom), LAB5 bar, B2B fan-out, signals, GND pour

rules_note: Project rules live in the committed PWR_B.kicad_pro (generated by make_spec.py): the project defaults of pcb/generated/netclasses.json project_defaults (track 0.15 / clearance 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5) and its net classes SIG (Default), PWR1A, PWR2A, PWR3A with the outer minimum width as track width. pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru is not copied: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it.

list.source: one board per device; template refs and nets are the graph refs and nets (pcb/generated/partition.json domains PWR_BRANCH_SW, USB_POWER_SW)

instances.spares_source: no spare board planned (build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB); a fab panel minimum is a purchasing matter

parts.pins_source: generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_B/make_spec.py b2b_pin_map() from pcb/generated/b2b-nets.json (sha256 0070cf483d67c0ba2cb0b29629961b04f89c11126aa82bebad9b510c98d44705): every crossing net with its contact count, one GND contact per power net
parts.replaced_by: graph ref of the Samtec QTH-060-01-L-D-A (pcb/partition-spec.json b2b.mpn.pwr_b) once its land pattern is read and vendored (GR-4 / PCB-PWRA / PCB-PWRB lineage), keeping this pin map
parts.pending: B2B ref pending: Samtec QTH-060-01-L-D-A land pattern not read, no graph ref yet (GR-3 OPEN)
parts.why_placeholder: The QTH-060-01-L-D-A has no KiCad 10.0.7 footprint and Samtec's recommended PCB layout was not readable (GR-3 for_dependents: suddendocs.samtec.com prints 403 on 2026-11-07), so pcb/partition-spec.json b2b has no graph ref. The placeholder is the official KiCad 10.0.7 Hirose FX8-120P-SV land (2 x 60 contacts, 0.6 mm pitch, courtyard 43.6 x 7.9 against the QTH-060 catalogue outline 40.0 x 7.11, F-226 qth.pdf), so the fan-out, the pin map and the PWR-A mate position can be routed and checked now. It is not the part to buy; its socket Connector_Hirose_FX8:Hirose_FX8-120S-SV_2x60_P0.6mm (sha256 82ef2a7f5fbd930b90d97ef39fd59bbc18f8f31c22ec51cee135ad045241a67b) is the PWR-A placeholder mate.

b2b_pin_map.connector: B2B1 (placeholder for the Samtec QTH-060-01-L-D-A, bottom side)

mate.rule: PCB-PWRA-2 puts the mate on the PWR-A top under B2B1 (connectors.json enclosure_xy of every contact) and gives each contact the same net (check_boards b2b, pin_map identity)

b2b_pin_map.rule: contacts per crossing net from b2b-nets.json (ceil(I_protection / 1 A) for power nets, else 1) and one GND contact per power net; odd (lower) row from contact 119 in LOWER_ORDER, even (upper) row from 120 in UPPER_ORDER (make_spec.py), the ch4 Kelvin pair and BIAS_CH4_DAMP on the free upper contact under their pad

placement_rules.edges: harness headers on the board edges with the mating face outwards: CTRL-bound J202, J203, J201 and the SL3-bound J506 on the bottom edge, J508 on the right edge between the hole keepouts, the SL2-bound J207 and J204 on the top edge (contract edge_zones; the right edge holds one PH 6 only, see build/15 W2 PCB-PWRB)
placement_rules.reserve: the arm of the L (x 0-42, y 35-110) carries no part: it stays free for the PWR-A windows and edge strips that PCB-PWRA places (pcb/partition-budget.json windows and edge strips)
placement_rules.kelvin: INA3221 U215 between the ch1-ch3 shunts; every shunt net is scripted copper (current path plus sense take-off from the shunt pads); ch4 senses through the B2B to U216 on PWR-A

warning_checks.footprint_filters_mismatch: schematic-parity check; per-board PCBs are not linked to the multi-sheet schematic, so DRC runs without --schematic-parity and the source-pad audit replaces it
warning_checks.missing_tuning_profile: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.generic_warning: KiCad's catch-all warning class; any instance is listed in report.json and reviewed
warning_checks.silk_over_copper: legend only: the fab clips legend over exposed copper; library outlines of the JST and FX8 footprints sit close to their pads
warning_checks.silk_overlap: legend only: overlapping legend items are cosmetic; every instance is listed in report.json
